answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an ocean bet on surviving 107 epochs of grading, and every dune settlement recomputes the lotus schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 107 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
